profile.headline: Freelance Software Engineer @ Freelance | Creative Website Solutions
profile.summary:
SmartBug Media relies on a collaborative team of developers to deliver innovative, user-focused web solutions. As part of this team, I contribute to the creation of responsive, interactive websites that prioritize maintainability and modularity. Leveraging expertise in WordPress, custom HTML/CSS, and JavaScript frameworks such as Angular and Three.js, I help ensure seamless user experiences and high-impact designs for clients across diverse industries, utilizing HubSpot and other CMS platforms.   

With over three years at SmartBug Media and more than a decade of freelance web development experience, my focus remains on combining creative design principles with cutting-edge technologies. Passionate about detail-oriented development and agile workflows, I aim to empower businesses with websites that drive engagement and build brand loyalty.

positions.description:
SmartBug Media is a nationally recognized inbound marketing agency working to make clients successful in inbound marketing, creative, conversion rate optimization, growth-driven design, web design, PR, and sales enablement. We assist businesses in generating leads, increasing awareness, and building brand loyalty. 

Since 2007, SmartBug Media has been helping businesses increase sales leads, close more customers, and enhance the reach of their brands. SmartBug is one of a handful of HubSpot Elite partners in the world and is the highest-rated agency in the history of the HubSpot ecosystem.
